GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (18 Mar 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 825)
APO 500
18 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Suspension of Repatriation from Japan to Ryukyus.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 370.05 (5 Jan 46) GC, dated 5 January 1946, subject: "Repatriation to Ryukyus."
b. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese government, file AG 370.05 (14 Jan 46) GC, dated 14 January 1946, subject: "Repatriation to Ryukyus."
2. All repatriation to the Ryukyus from Japan is suspended effective immediately until further notice. Repatriation from Ryukyus to Japan will continue. Provisions of reference 1a and 1b above will be amended accordingly.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
